authority_basis.verification: Exact finite combinatorial checker with explicit permutation witnesses.

operations.title: Tree-face exactification of the 34-component flavor carrier atlas
operations.body: Filter canonical eight-link faces to those connected on the nine Q-u-d vertices; reconstruct explicit S3^3 permutations to canonical support and compute a component spanning tree.

operations.title: Connected tree faces give an exact codimension-one carrier groupoid on all 61 flavor presentations
operations.body: There are 28 connected canonical eight-link face types. Each is a tree, so it has no phase holonomy and support permutation plus vertex rephasing gives an exact weak-basis arrow. These faces induce 391 component pairs and contain a 33-edge spanning tree on all 34 prior components. Together with the exact within-component groupoid, all 61 presentations lie in one exact codimension-one carrier groupoid.

operations.title: Nima reports an exact tree-face spanning groupoid for all 61 flavor presentations
operations.body: The global exactification is now finite and complete at carrier level. Among the canonical eight-link faces, 28 are connected on all nine Q-u-d vertices, hence are trees with no loop holonomy. Their support permutations and vertex rephasings are exact weak-basis arrows. They generate 391 component pairs and contain a deterministic 33-edge spanning tree on all 34 prior components; with the exact within-component arrows, all 61 presentations lie in one exact codimension-one carrier groupoid. The next test is coefficient-level: transport the loop-phase line along the spanning tree and audit fundamental-cycle holonomy from the remaining exact arrows.
